name: andon
title_zh: 给线上系统装上会喊疼的仪表盘和病历本
tagline_zh: 服务挂了才翻日志，等于病人晕倒才量血压。它把日志、指标、链路、健康检查、告警串成一条线。
tagline_en: Logs, metrics, traces, health checks and alerts wired into one line, so you see which part slowed down and which.
desc_en: Make software health, failure, degradation, and recovery visible through useful observability and diagnostics. Use when adding logs, metrics, traces, health checks, alerts, incident signals, or operational feedback.
why_zh: 它不堆工具名，只逼你先回答「出事了我想先看到什么」，再倒推该埋哪些信号、阈值定在哪。
why_en: It doesn't name-drop tools. It makes you answer 'what do I want to see first when it breaks', then derives the signals.
limit_zh: 它只产出可观测性方案与埋点设计，不替你部署 Prometheus、Grafana 或任何后端。
limit_en: It designs the observability plan and instrumentation only — it won't deploy Prometheus, Grafana or any backend. No structured logs yet? Fix that.
title_en: Give your running system a dashboard that can say ouch
